meta.description: Gene and region-based rare-variant aggregation - burden/collapsing, SKAT, SKAT-O, ACAT-V/ACAT-O, annotation-weighted STAAR - with regenie (--vc-tests), SAIGE-GENE+, and the SKAT R package. Single-variant tests are powerless at low minor allele count, so rare variants are aggregated across a gene or region under an explicit mask (functional class plus a MAF cutoff). A burden test collapses variants into one score assuming a single effect direction (powerful when true, near-zero power when risk and protective variants cancel); SKAT is a variance-component test robust to mixed directions; SKAT-O blends the two; ACAT/STAAR are dependence-robust and annotation-weighted. The mask is the hypothesis, imbalance needs SPA or Firth, and testing burden is per-gene-per-mask. Use when aggregating rare coding or regulatory variants into gene or region tests, choosing burden vs SKAT vs SKAT-O, or building masks. For single-variant GWAS see association-testing; for mask annotations see variant-calling/variant-annotation.
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill (fork commit c1237cdb). Mode A. WSL agents distro via tar hand-over: plink2 a6.9, regenie 4.1.3, r-saige 1.3.1 (with SKAT 2.2.5); Windows R 4.4.3 with SKAT 2.2.5 in the candidate R library. Data SYNTHETIC (data/make_rv_data.py, seed 20260915): 2,000 unrelated samples, 180 cases, 1,200 common array SNPs, 30 genes / 462 rare variants; planted G01 burden, G11 mixed-direction, G21 LoF-only. The 5 pre-fix inputs were re-run from runs/p_in1..p_in5 (shipped example taken from the fork commit; SAIGE strings swapped for the post-fix text); inputs 6 and 7 are new (runs/in6, runs/in7). n_inputs 7 = 5 regression + 2 new. Not executed: the SAIGE bgen form end to end (no .bgen/.bgi built; the printed command was run to check argument handling) and STAAR (text only). Inputs executed: 7/7.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; all eight method references (Li & Leal 2008 through Zhou 2022) are real and correctly attributed.

practice_boundaries.detail: Cohort-level gene tests only; the individual-attribution request (input 7) was declined.

methodological_ground.detail: Test selection verified on planted architectures; imbalance handled with Firth/SPA; masks counted in the multiple-testing burden.

code_usability.detail: regenie, SAIGE (PLINK form), SKAT and SSD code ran; the bgen command's missing --chrom/--LOCO stops with an explicit SAIGE error and is recorded as P2.

functional_suitability.note: Test-selection logic is correct and the fixed recipes ran: step 1 with --bt, the example with separate array/exome prefixes, SAIGE's comma/semicolon semantics (matches step2_SPAtests.R --help), the .all mask statement, the SKAT and SSD routes. Remaining gap: the printed SAIGE bgen command stops with 'chrom needs to be specified in order to apply Leave-one-chromosome-out on gene- or region-based tests' because it sets neither --chrom nor --LOCO=FALSE.

reliability.note: Common Errors covers skat-o, burden-file mismatches and imbalance; the step-1 --bt and low-variance traps now sit only in code comments, and the LOCO/--chrom requirement is absent.

agent_usability.note: Mechanism-first framing; the SAIGE separator comment is now correct and would steer an agent right.

human_usability.note: Usage-guide prompts map to the decision tree.

maintainability.note: Shipped example now runs end to end with separate step-1/step-2 genotype sets; no test data ships.

agent_specific.note: Precise scope with explicit routing to association-testing, variant-annotation and clinical-databases/variant-prioritization.

recommendations.title: SAIGE bgen command omits --chrom or --LOCO=FALSE
recommendations.problem: The printed step2_SPAtests.R bgen command now parses but stops: 'chrom needs to be specified in order to apply Leave-one-chromosome-out on gene- or region-based tests'.
recommendations.root_cause: LOCO is on by default in SAIGE 1.3.1 and the set-test command gives no chromosome.
recommendations.fix: Add `--chrom <chr>` (one run per chromosome with a LOCO null) or `--LOCO=FALSE`, and state which applies.

recommendations.title: SSD route does not warn about sample order
recommendations.problem: SKAT_Null_Model data are matched to SSD genotypes by position; the Skill never says the covariate table must follow the .fam order.
recommendations.root_cause: Sample alignment is implicit in the SKAT API.
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line check, e.g. `stopifnot(identical(fam$V2, covar_df$IID))`, before fitting the null model.

recommendations.title: Common Errors misses step-1 trait-type and variance traps
recommendations.problem: The regenie errors 'very few unique values' (no --bt) and 'low variance' (rare SNPs in step 1) are explained only in code comments.
recommendations.fix: Add both rows with their fixes (--bt; fit step 1 on QC'd common variants).
